description:
YPulse is a research service focused on Gen Z and Millennials (ages 13–39) — covering tweens, teens, college students, young adults, and young parents across North America and Western Europe, with over a decade of syndicated survey data.

It tracks brand perception (awareness, favorability, usage), behavioral trends (spending, social media, entertainment, finance, health, dating), and publishes editorial content/reports on youth culture. It doesn't cover Gen X, Boomers, or anyone over 40.

defaultPrompt: How do Gen Z and Millennials feel about Crocs right now, and how has that shifted over the past year?
What percentage of teens are using BNPL (buy now, pay later) services, and how has that trended over time?
What's YPulse's latest research on how young people think about AI in dating apps?
